candidateIdentity.variantName: Black dial on supplied black B-TYPE nylon band

sourceChecks.note: Bertucci's current exact-reference page separates black-dial, black-band 12022 from adjacent color and band SKUs and publishes USD 185, a 40 mm matte solid-titanium Unibody case, integrated titanium band-retention bars, supplied black B-TYPE nylon band, hardened mineral crystal, ergonomic 4 o'clock crown, Swiss luminous hands and markers that glow for hours, date, and 200 m construction. Retrieved 2026-08-30.
Bertucci's current A-2T manufacturer dimension drawing publishes 40 mm diameter, 49.5 mm overall lug-to-lug span, and 11 mm thickness. Retrieved and visually checked 2026-08-30.

Bertucci's current A-2T Original Classic feature sheet publishes 62 g configured weight, 22 mm band size, 200 m water resistance, screw-down crown and caseback, hardened mineral crystal, all-metal Japanese quartz, date, and the stated three-year battery configuration. Retrieved and visually checked 2026-08-30.

The current Japanese authorized distributor identifies exact reference 12022 and independently repeats the 40 mm sandblasted solid-titanium case, mineral glass, titanium screw-down crown and back, 20 ATM/200 m rating, date, Swiss Super-LumiNova, nylon band, and a Miyota GM10 or Miyota 2S60 movement alternative. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Miyota's official GM10 specification publishes a -20/+20-second-per-month rate, date, and approximately three-year battery life. It validates the accuracy shared by one of the exact distributor-listed alternatives without asserting which calibre is fitted to an individual 12022. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Miyota's official 2S60 specification publishes the same -20/+20-second-per-month rate and date, with a different ten-year battery claim. The row therefore accepts the shared accuracy but retains calibre and battery endurance as unresolved alternatives. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

The exact 12022 black/black retail offer is currently USD 185 and exposes an in-stock Add to Cart path. No authorized-dealer representation was found on the listing, so the acquisition snapshot is conservatively classified as new grey-market stock. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

The exact-reference retailer reports 100 m and 1.9 oz/about 53.9 g, conflicting with Bertucci's current exact-family 200 m and 62 g feature sheet. Those stale retailer dimensions are rejected and do not override current manufacturer assets. Retrieved 2026-08-30.
